title: Omugobe w’Ennyana ya Zaabu
intro: Ekifaananyi ekyogerwako mu Quran kyaleetera ekibiina ekinene okukyama mu kiseera nga nnabbi ow’ekitiibwa teyaliiwo. Ekintu ekyakolebwa mu zaabu kyakwata emitima gy’eggwanga lyonna — naye emboozi y’omuntu ono ssekinnoomu ekoma mu kweyawula n’ekikolimo ekyewuunyisa. Omugobe ono ayinza okuba ani?
clues: Navaayo mu kiseera nga tewali nnabbi omukulu eyali alinnye okufuna obulagirizi obw’obwakatonda.
Nabuzaabuza ekibiina ekinene n’ekintu kye nnayiiya n’emikono gyange.
Ekitonde ekya zaabu kye nnafulumya kyalabika ng’ekirina obulamu, nga kifulumya amaloboozi agawuniikiriza abo abaakigoberera.
Nagamba nti nnalaba abalala bye bataasobola kutegeera — akabonero akalaga ebitalabika.
Nasika ekintu okuva mu bigere by’omubaka ow’obwakatonda ne nkisuula mu kyuma ekisaanuuse.
Nasalirwa omusango okutaayaaya nzekka, nga nnina ekikolimo eky’enjawulo nti tewali ayinza kukwata ku lususu lwange wadde nze okukwata ku lwabwe.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Okuwang’anguse, okugaanibwa okukwatibwako oba okukwata ku balala
Yakubwa wansi empewo ey’amaanyi era eyali ewuuma
Asonyiyibwa era n’asitulwa okutuuka ku siteegi eya waggulu
outcome.answer: Okuwang’anguse, okugaanibwa okukwatibwako oba okukwata ku balala

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
